training.method: Supervised stimulus-decoder calibration on synthetic four-cue probes. Target is the smoothed win-value encoded into stimulus channel one; no poker games or biological learning are claimed for this calibration dataset. All probes run the full fixed connectome. Independent held-out seed groups select the readout.
training.target: Laplace-smoothed finite-sample win fraction (wins+1)/(samples+2); an immediate finish is encoded as [1,1,1,1] with target one.
